svg.title: Swap only X.
svg.desc: Two AnnData layouts. In H5AD, X is stored as CSR arrays (indptr, indices, data). In H5CP, the same X is a CellPack matrix that takes about a tenth of the space; obs, var, obsm, obsp, varm, varp, layers and uns are unchanged.

text.font-family: 'CP Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
'CP Head', 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif

g.text: An H5CP file is an H5AD file whose X is a CellPack matrix. Everything else keeps its AnnData encoding.
